entries.modifications_and_rationale: Lab changes kept (invalid zone = configuration error, invalid instant rejected, assertTimeZone, calendar date only — never the business date, DEC-042). entries.accepted_use: Converting UTC event timestamps to the property's calendar date for display/validation; validating the property timezone on configuration save.
entries.excluded_uses: Deciding or advancing the business date; night audit; fiscal-period assignment.
